propositions: The AC1 snapshot equivalence contract test re-calls compose_operation_snapshot with identical arguments across CLI, Python, MCP, and reconciler surfaces, making its assertions trivially true and unable to catch if real surfaces stop routing through the composer.

Real MCP entry point (build_server + call_tool) and reconciler entry point (main with argv) must be driven end-to-end instead of re-composing in test code, with the composer instrumented at module-global resolution time to verify each surface actually invokes it.

Each surface's snapshot must be independently anchored to absolute expected content (repo root, envelope version, config key provenance from project and env layers) in addition to cross-surface equality comparison, preventing vacuous passing when all surfaces move together after composer perturbation.

The test must fail explicitly when a surface composes no snapshot (via empty recorder assertion) rather than silently looping over nothing, and must detect composer mutations by failing on provenance mismatches in the surface-specific assertions.
